text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-T-04, Rousseau Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull

Unique, the Rousseau Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull has cone mounts. It is simple enough to transition from one ascetic to the next while still being attractive enough to add a little pizzazz to any room. What is great about the Rousseau Pull is that it is timeless--blending seamlessly from retro spaces to contemporary ones and everything in between. This cabinet pull makes it easy to revive your decor by simply replacing the existing hardware without having to remodel everything around it. Made out of stainless steel, it has a brushed stainless steel finish.

Also Available Matching Rousseau Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Rousseau Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Center to Center: 4"
  • Overall Length: 4-5/8"
  • Height: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
